questions.stem: A 52-year-old female comes for her annual physical examination. Upon auscultation, a third heart sound (S3) is heard. The differential diagnosis of this finding includes which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
Anemia

The third heart sound (S3) is associated with rapid ventricular filling of the left ventricle. S3 is commonly heard in children and young adults and is also heard in conditions when the rapid filling of the ventricle is abnormally high, for example, in anemia or mitral regurgitation.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page No.567-569.

questions.stem: A 47-year-old anephric patient revealed anemia symptoms. What is the cause of these symptoms?
questions.solutionHtml:
Reduced synthesis of erythropoietins

An anephric person doesn’t have a kidney, thus he will have anemia resulting from decreased EPO production.




Ganong's Review of Medical Physiology, 26th Edition, Page No.567-569.

questions.stem: A “Himalayan Yogi” permanently lives high in the mountains. What changes in blood characteristics can be found in this organism?

options.label: C
options.text: Decrease of the color index of blood

questions.solutionHtml:
Increase of erythrocytes number

At high altitudes, the number of RBCs increases.




Guyton and Hall, Textbook of Medical Physiology, 14th Edition, Page Number:448.

questions.stem: A 29-year-old man met with a road traffic accident and was brought to the hospital. While he was carried to the hospital via ambulance the paramedics started giving him fluids intravenously and unfortunately by mistake despite normal saline solution, they infused 1000 ml of distilled water. What should be the shape of the red blood cells of the patient and plasma osmolarity respectively?
questions.solutionHtml:
Swollen, hypoosmotic

As distilled water is given, the plasma osmolarity decreases. This leads to the movement of water inside the RBCs and makes them swollen.




Guyton and Hall Textbook of physiology 14th Edition, Page No 312

questions.stem: Death due to cyanide poisoning results from which of the following types of hypoxia?
questions.solutionHtml:
Histotoxic hypoxia

Cyanide poisoning causes histotoxic hypoxia because it blocks the mitochondria from consuming oxygen.




Guyton and Hall Textbook of physiology Edition 14th; Page No 315
